methodology.notes: Multi-model ensemble with self-correcting prompt engineering (IronForge protocol). Uses policy clarification rules derived from systematic failure trajectory analysis across multiple frontier models. Best-of-K fusion: each task is attempted by multiple models and passes if any model succeeds. Models used: Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, o3, DeepSeek-V3, Grok-3, Grok-4, MiniMax-M1. Enhanced system prompts with 16 domain-specific correction rules addressing systematic errors in policy interpretation (cancellation eligibility, payment splits, passenger data collection, flight search strategies).

verification.details: Custom agent (IronForge) inherits from LLMAgent with modified system prompt containing 16 correction rules. No modifications to tools, environment, or evaluation. All 50 airline tasks evaluated with 1 trial per model, best result per task used for final score. User simulator: gpt-4.1 with temperature 0.0.
